rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, and H3 headings. Apply 'tracking-tight'.
Use Outfit for body text with 'tracking-wide' and 'leading-relaxed' for an editorial feel.
Overlines/Subtitles must be Outfit, uppercase, text-xs or text-sm, with 'tracking-[0.2em]' (e.g., 'EL ESTUDIO').
Never use default sans for headings. Maintain a cinematic and regal typographic hierarchy.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (The 'Breathing Room' Rule). Use 2-3x more padding than standard SaaS.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento grids with extreme asymmetry for the gallery. Strict 3-col grids for services.
spacing_and_layout.animation: Subtle fade-ins, very slow organic drifts. No bouncy or rapid animations.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#D4B896] text-[#D4B896] hover:bg-[#D4B896] hover:text-[#050505] transition-all duration-300 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm px-8 py-4
buttons.secondary: text-white hover:text-[#D4B896] transition-colors duration-300 underline-offset-4 hover:underline

cards.base: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/5 hover:border-[#D4B896]/30 transition-colors duration-500 rounded-none p-8

inputs.base: bg-transparent border-b border-white/10 hover:border-[#D4B896]/50 focus:border-[#D4B896] focus:ring-0 rounded-none px-0 py-3 text-white placeholder:text-white/30 transition-colors

ui_components.icons: lucide-react with strokeWidth={1} for a thin, elegant, fine-line look.

sections.name: Navigation
sections.details: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with a 1px bottom border of white/5. Logo centered or on the left. Navigation links should be subtle. 'Reservar' CTA on the right.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Cinematic overlay. Use the generated `hero_background` image with `bg-black/60` overlay. Big serif headline in Spanish: 'El Arte de la Tinta Elevado'. Secondary text: 'Void Tattoo Studio. Diseño exclusivo, precisión y lujo en cada detalle.' CTA: 'Reservar Cita'.

sections.name: About
sections.details: Editorial layout. Left side: generated `about_image`. Right side: H2 'Nuestra Filosofía', text explaining the luxury approach to tattooing. Use the crest logo watermark subtly in the background.

sections.name: Services
sections.details: 3-column grid of minimalist dark cards. Services: Tatuaje Permanente, Cover-up, Tatuajes Temporales, Piercing, Diseño Personalizado, Retoques. Include a very thin gold line or icon for each.

sections.name: Gallery
sections.details: Asymmetrical masonry grid (The Tetris Grid) showcasing the minimalist fine line tattoo close-up images. Use grayscale filter with hover to reveal full contrast/subtle color.

sections.name: Artists
sections.details: Cards showing the tattoo artists working in black and white. Include name, specialty, and years of experience. High-end fashion editorial vibe.

sections.name: Stats
sections.details: Minimalist counter section. E.g., '10+ Años de Experiencia', '5k+ Clientes Satisfechos', 'Custom Designs'. Use the `dark_gold_texture` as a subtle background here.

sections.name: FAQ
sections.details: Use Shadcn Accordion. Dark, unstyled look with just a bottom border for each item. Questions about pain, healing process, custom designs, etc.

sections.name: Booking Form (WhatsApp)
sections.details: A clean, dark luxury form. Fields: Nombre, Email, Teléfono, Tipo de Servicio, Fecha, Comentarios. ON SUBMIT: Construct a WhatsApp URL (`https://wa.me/1234567890?text=...`) using the form data and open it in a new tab. Do NOT send to a backend.

sections.name: Footer
sections.details: Massive spacing. Large 'VOID TATTOO' serif text. Contact info, studio location (fictional premium location), Instagram link (@void.tattoo.studio), and copyright.

logo.description: VOID Tattoo Studio crest logo (Gold on black)
logo.usage: Navbar, Footer, and optionally as a massive low-opacity background watermark in the About section.

hero_background.description: Cinematic dark empty tattoo studio interior with subtle gold accents
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with black/60 overlay.

texture_background.description: Abstract dark luxury background with fine noise texture
texture_background.usage: Background for the Stats or FAQ section to break up the solid black.

about_image.description: Macro shot of a tattoo machine on dark leather with warm gold rim light
about_image.usage: Main image for the 'Sobre Nosotros' (About) section.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a Dark Luxury aesthetic. Stick strictly to black (#050505), off-black (#0A0A0A), and the provided champagne gold (#D4B896).
Do NOT use bright white backgrounds anywhere. The entire site is dark mode.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. You MUST use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for headings to give it a regal, editorial feel, and 'Outfit' (sans) for body text. Load these via Google Fonts.
Borders should be extremely subtle, usually 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05) or the gold accent color at low opacity.
Include 'lucide-react' icons but apply 'strokeWidth={1}' to them so they match the fine-line minimalist luxury vibe.

For the booking form: Do NOT set up a backend API to send emails. Instead, capture the form state in React, and on submit, build a URL: `https://wa.me/34600000000?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}` and use `window.open(url, '_blank')`.
Apply 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and form inputs.
Ensure all copy is in Spanish.
Build the UI in /app/frontend. Make sure to use Tailwind CSS properly.
For the gallery, use a CSS grid with different spans (e.g., col-span-2 row-span-2) to create a 'bento' or 'masonry' feel.
